---
title: "The book"
---

***Foundations of Clinical Research — From Clinical Question to Publication*** is the companion textbook (381 pages, 20 chapters in four parts, 163 figures, 116 references). It explains everything taught in the course in full and can be read on its own, from asking a research question to designing, analysing, writing and publishing a study, with worked examples throughout and a complete case study of the FLUID-ICU dataset.
